image_description: A full suit of polished steel plate armor standing in a museum setting. The image focuses on the torso, featuring a highly reflective breastplate with embossed floral or scrollwork patterns and gold-colored trim/straps. Below the breastplate is a fauld (waist armor) with horizontal lames. The background shows wooden doors and a light-colored wall.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The horizontal lames of the fauld show slight softness and lack the crisp, sharp edges typical of real steel plate armor. The reflections on these lower plates are slightly more diffuse than on the breastplate, suggesting minor texture inconsistency or AI smoothing.

The gold-colored strap on the right side (viewer's left) appears to merge slightly into the metal of the pauldron/shoulder defense rather than having a distinct mechanical attachment point (like a rivet or buckle). It looks somewhat 'painted on' or fused.
The vertical lines of the wooden door frames in the background show very slight waviness, not perfectly straight, which is a common subtle artifact in AI-generated interiors.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from generic 'armor' or other chest protection types.
To analyze the physical correctness of the complex reflections on the curved metal surface, a key indicator of realism.
To verify if the decorative straps are distinct objects attached to the plate or if they suffer from fusion/melting artifacts.
To ensure the armor is properly separated from the background and does not exhibit foreground-background bleeding.

focus_areas: Reflectivity and specular highlights on curved metal surfaces
Sharpness of embossed details vs. base metal smoothness
Geometric consistency of the fauld (waist armor) lames
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'fusion' of the gold straps. In real armor, these would be distinct leather or metal pieces attached via rivets or buckles. If they look like part of the steel texture, it is an artifact. Also, check if the embossed pattern maintains consistent depth and lighting across the curved surface.
